title: Choose the text-route identity by clustering whole sheets versus single panels
body: After drawing many sheets from a prompt, the pipeline keeps the group whose faces agree most, as in the paper 'The Chosen One'. Panels on one sheet share lighting and rendering, so a sheet may look more consistent than its person really is, and clustering whole sheets could pick a weaker identity than clustering panels one by one. Choose the identity both ways, train a LoRA from each with everything else fixed, and compare face agreement on the suite. Sheet clustering is worth keeping only if its LoRAs agree at least as well.
